mapper.sql: id, trip_date, trip_part, user_id, trip_typ, trip_day
mapper.insert:
insert into tb_trip_detail
id,
trip_date,
trip_part,
user_id,
trip_typ,
trip_day,
#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER},
#{tripDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
#{tripPart,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
#{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
#{tripTyp,jdbcType=CHAR},
#{tripDay,jdbcType=DOUBLE},
mapper.update: update tb_attendance a,tb_trip_detail b set a.all_day=b.trip_typ where b.id=#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.user_id=b.user_id and b.trip_part='all' and a.check_date=b.trip_date
update tb_attendance a,tb_trip_detail b set a.mor_day=b.trip_typ where b.id=#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.user_id=b.user_id and b.trip_part='mor' and a.check_date=b.trip_date
update tb_attendance a,tb_trip_detail b set a.aft_day=b.trip_typ where b.id=#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.user_id=b.user_id and b.trip_part='aft' and a.check_date=b.trip_date
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.trip_date, a.trip_part, a.user_id, a.trip_typ, a.trip_day from tb_trip_detail a inner join tb_trip b on (a.id=b.id and b.status in ('97','98','99'))
AND a.USER_ID = '${userId}'
AND a.TRIP_DATE = '${tripDate}'
